name: Es no Houteishiki
source:
"Es no Houteishiki" is the second game in the Detective Suzusaki series. The events described in the previous game, "Kuro no Danshou ~The Literary Fragment~", led to a series of suicides, but the case was believed to be closed. But Kusanagi, the young brilliant psychologist and assistant of the famous detective Suzusaki, has now to face his own past. The traces lead to a remote village, which has seen nine mysterious, unsolved murders in eleven years. Soon, Kusanagi discovers a strange religious cult, that might shed some light on his past...

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/es-no-hteishiki]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
《Es的方程式》是凉崎侦探事务所系列第二作。前作《黑之断章》所描绘的事件引发了一连串自杀，但人们原以为案件已经告一段落。如今，年轻的天才心理学家草薙——著名侦探凉崎聪的助手——不得不直面自己的过去。线索指向一座偏远村庄；过去11年间，那里发生过九起至今未破的神秘谋杀案。不久后，草薙发现了一个诡异的宗教团体，它或许能为草薙的过往带来一线答案……

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/es-no-hteishiki]Moby Games[/url]]
